locations.note: Mata Hari arrives in 1905 to dance her way into Paris society, and later photographs the British ambassador's papers at the embassy for French counter-intelligence.
Her German handler Major von Kalle sets her on the Jules Verne Project, a 29-metre cannon; in 1912 she gets Fokker's airfoil at the Daimler factory.
In Monaco she delivers film and sets up Samsonet, and the 1914 climax is at the poison gas factory, where she impersonates Haber.
In 1912 she taps von Kalle's phone in Madrid, overhears an assassination plan in Serbia and sets up a meeting.
